content: Nasundeccu, vama ñotsse in'jan'faja: Chiga que'i na'su sefacconi can'jemba que'ima caña'jen. Tsa'cansi que'imbe semasundeccuma panshaen mandambe'yi tise'pama ñotsse tson'faja.
Anttembe'yi Chigama iñajamba canse'faja. Anambiqquia'caen injama'chone Chigama ñotsse afapa iñajan'faja.

Toya'caen ingine'qque Chigama iñajan'faja cuintsu Tise osha'chove ñoñasi, ingija ñotsse condase'choma candusiamba, va tayoe condambi'choa Cristone condase'choma'qque condaseye. Nane tsama condasepa gi piccoyepa can'jen.
Chigama iñajan'faja ña a'tatsse candusiañe. Nane tsa'caen candusiañe tsu Chigaja in'jan.
Jesúsve in'jambindeqquiai'ccu can'je'an'qque ñotsse in'jamba canse'faja. Injanga can'jembe'yi poi a'ta ma'caen tsoñe osha'ta tson'faja.
Tise'pai'ccu ñotsse condasecco'faya'cho. Nane que'ija Cristove in'jamba condase'faya'cho. Tsa'camba majan que'ima Cristone iñajampañasi qui tise'panga ñotsse condaye osha'faya.
Faenga'su Jesucristove in'jan'cho Tíquico tsu ña mingae can'jen'choma que'inga condaseya. Tiseja fae'ngae ñai'ccu Na'su Jesúsne sema'supa ñama fuitesi gi tisema ñotsse in'jan.
Tsa'cansi gi tisema que'ini moen cuintsu tise condasesi que'ija ingi ma'caen can'jen'choma atesu'faye. Toya'caen tsu que'i injama'choma tsa'caen quiñaeña.
Tisei'ccu gi Onésimoma'qque moen. Tiseja que'ini'supa Cristove in'jamba ingi in'jan'cho faenga'su tsu. Tsendeccuja que'inga japa pa'cco vani tson'jen'choma tsu condase'faya.

Ñai'ccu fae'ngae piccoye'cho Aristarco'qque que'ima chigambiañe in'jan. Bernabé antian Marcos'qque que'ima chigambiañe in'jan. Nane Marcosneja tayo gi que'inga condase. Tise tseni que'inga ja'ninda tisema ñotsse ca'nian'faja.

Toya'caen Jesús Justo'qque que'ima chigambian. Nane Cristove in'jan'cho israendeccu'suja va tresyi tsu ñai'ccu fae'ngae sema'jen'fa, Na'su Chigambe a'ive daya'chone condaseye. Tsendeccu ñama fuitesi gi injama'choni avujatssi.

Epafrasja, que'ini'supa que'ima chigambiañe in'jan. Tise'qque Jesúsne sema'su tsu. Chigama iñajamba ñoa'me aqque'pambe que'ine iñajan'jen cuintsu que'i Chiga in'jan'choma ñoa'me in'jamba tsa'caen tson'faye.
Epafrasja que'ine, Laodicea canqquesundeccune, Hierápolis canqquesundeccune'qque tsain'bitsse in'jamba sema'jen. Nane tise'pa sema'jen'choma atesupa gi que'inga conda.
Lucas, ingi in'jan'cho seje'su, Demas'qque que'ima chigambian'fa.
Ña'qque gi Laodicia'su Cristove in'jan'chondeccuma chigambiañe in'jan. Toya'caen gi Ninfasma, tise tsaoni bo'fa'chondeccuma'qque chigambian.
Que'ija va tevaen'jenma camba afapa poiyi'cco pañamba Laodicia'su Cristove in'jamba bo'fa'chonga moen'faja. Que'i'qque ña Laodiceandeccunga tevaen'choma isupa camba afa'faja.
Arquiponga'qque qquen condase'faja: “Que'i Na'su a'ipa tise que'ima mandasi sema'jen'choma ñotsse nanijan.”
Ña, Pablo gi ña tivei'ccu va chigambian'choma tevaen. Ña piccoyepa can'jen'choma injan'jen'faja. In'jan gi Chiga que'ima ñotsse tsoñe. Tsangaeyi.
